simple.meaning: נָצַץ (nâtsats) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to glare , i.e. be bright-colored.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Ezekiel, beginning at Ezekiel 1:7. Its meaning becomes clearer as the uses are compared.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to נָצַץ (H5340) in the Hebrew text.

definitions.full: H5340. natsats I. [ נָצַץ ] verb shine, sparkle (Late Hebrew נִצְנֵץ ; akin to Arabic sparkle, flash , נְעָא ᵑ7 ); — Qal Participle נְחשֶׁת כְּעֵין וְנֹצְצִים Ezek 1:7 (of cherubim); — Perles Anal.45 proposes נוֺצִיצָם their plumage ( ׳נ || form of נוֺצָה ), compare Ew.

occurrences.englishText: Their feet were straight feet. The sole of their feet was like the sole of a calf’s foot; and they sparkled like burnished bronze.
